patch_description: The simulated annealing phase intentionally accepts deteriorating moves, but the existing implementation returns the final annealing state rather than the best configuration encountered. This can discard a substantially better maximin arrangement found earlier in the search. Record the global incumbent whenever any feasible proposal improves the true minimum-area objective, then restore it before deterministic pattern refinement. This is deterministic, has negligible runtime cost, and guarantees that annealing cannot reduce final solution quality.
